_note: Realtime monitor (mira/realtime.py, run_realtime.py). A profile runs when it has subscribers. Subscriber entries may be literal addresses or ${ENV_VAR} references resolved from .env. Relevance/credibility cutoffs are Jev-calibrated in mira/jev.py (CUTOFFS), not here. include_papers: also alert on new arXiv papers (off by default: the live agent is for news; papers are covered by the weekly digests).
